justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/CachedReturnPlugin.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/build/CachedReturnPluginOtherTest.java`. `AdviceResolver` is a compact enum with 9 type-specific constants, 1 constructor, and only 2 helper methods (`of` and `toAdvice`), plus one nested `ExitAdviceByteCodeAppender` shared by all constants. Its scope is narrow: select the correct advice implementation by return type and build the corresponding bytecode mapping. The code shows one cohesive responsibility rather than multiple separable responsibilities, so there is no clear evidence of insufficient modularization.
